description: Drill Down Donut PRO is a KPI aware donut visual for Power BI, designed for performance reporting rather than simple category breakdowns. It combines drill down interaction, category level targets, and built in KPI context directly inside the donut. This removes the need for separate KPI cards, tooltip explanations, or workaround measures. The result is a single visual that clearly communicates distribution, performance, and target alignment at a glance. Why choose Drill Down Donut PRO Regular Power BI donut charts fall short when reports need to answer real performance questions. Drill Down Donut PRO is built for reports where users need to: Compare actuals versus targets per category Keep KPIs visible while filtering or drilling down Easier exploration with one-click drill downs and cross-chart filtering Deliver visuals that explain themselves in executive and management reports Build reports that remain understandable after handover to other developers Key features ADVANCED DRILL DOWN INTERACTIONS - users can explore up to 9 levels of data step by step without losing context. Drill down actions preserve KPI visibility and visual clarity during navigation. Cross-filter chart with a single click.
